launcher.notes: SPLASH FIXED. The silent mid-load crash is gone: the custom Kinetrix loading screen no longer uses a second OpenGL thread (the thing that killed the game on some PCs) - Ultra Forge 4 draws every frame on the main thread, exactly like vanilla Forge's own loading screen, with progress fed by hooks into Forge's own progress system. Same look (Kinetrix emblem, orbit spinner, brand gradient, real-time percentage), same fail-safe design, and the Mojang fallback stays rebranded. Everything else from 2.7.0 is unchanged: Forge 1.8.9 + OptiFine M5 + Kinetrix FPS Boost + FoamFix in one jar with no extra mod loading, byte-exact forge jar verification, automatic sweep of old forge jars and stray mods-folder jars (no duplicates), and the bundled offline client stays v3.3.6.

notes: Launcher 2.7.1 "Splash Fixed": the silent crash halfway through loading is root-caused (the custom loading screen ran its animation on a second OpenGL thread - the exact topology vanilla Forge refuses next to OptiFine) and fixed in Ultra Forge 4 by drawing every frame on the main thread with progress hooks planted into Forge's own progress system - the animated Kinetrix emblem, orbit spinner, brand gradient and real-time percentage all stay. Old installs upgrade to Ultra Forge 4 automatically on the next launch (no duplicates, old forge jars swept). Client stays 3.3.6 (auto-updates in mods/).
